title: CLCON/10/2004 of RAM CHANDRA JOSHI Vs P.N.TIKKU and ORS.

paras.text:
CLCON No. 10 of 2004
Hon. P.C. Verma, A.C.J.
The contemnor has
complied the order passed by this
Court on 23.09.2003 and has
tendered his unconditional
apology. Apology is accepted.
Since the order stand complied
with, therefore, the contempt is
dismissed and notices discharged.
Contempt petition is
dismissed accordingly.
(P.C. Verma, A.C. J.)
Dt. 10.06.2004 HN
